title: Write the Conventions section of CLAUDE.md
body: The arbitrary but fixed choices, each settled in a word: abbreviation policy (prf/seq/fwd/bwd versus full words, and where each is allowed), naming affixes (_idx, is_, with_, from_), bail! and panic messages, test naming and return type, doc line style, extension trait naming, builders by hand or derive_builder. About ten lines in CLAUDE.md. Anything rustfmt or clippy already enforces is out of scope. The conventions the code already follows are in the notes.
